{"CommandLine":"~/.ansible/kssh -u superuser 172.30.198.33 '
python3 -c '\''
import urllib.request
import ssl
import sys

ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
ctx.check_hostname = False
ctx.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE

headers_to_test = {
    "X-Forwarded-Proto": "https",
    "X-Forwarded-Ssl": "on",
    "X-Forwarded-Port": "9443",
    "X-Forwarded-For": "172.30.198.33",
    "X-Real-IP": "172.30.198.33",
    "Forwarded": "for=172.30.198.33;proto=https",
    "X-Forwarded-Host": "map.extranetclient.outremer-telecom.fr",
    "Upgrade": "",
    "Connection": "close"
}

# Test baseline
req = urllib.request.Request("https://172.30.198.50:9443/centreon-map/", headers={"Host": "map.extranetclient.outremer-telecom.fr:9443"})
try:
    resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, context=ctx)
    print("Baseline:", resp.status)
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    print("Baseline:", e.code)

# Test with all headers combined
req = urllib.request.Request("https://172.30.198.50:9443/centreon-map/", headers={"Host": "map.extranetclient.outremer-telecom.fr:9443", **headers_to_test})
try:
    resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, context=ctx)
    print("All headers:", resp.status)
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    print("All headers:", e.code)

# Test one by one if all headers failed
for k, v in headers_to_test.items():
    req = urllib.request.Request("https://172.30.198.50:9443/centreon-map/", headers={"Host": "map.extranetclient.outremer-telecom.fr:9443", k: v})
    try:
        resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, context=ctx)
        print(f"Header {k}: {resp.status}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        print(f"Header {k}: {e.code}")
